audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side read Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Skill/Lissandra/Skill/Vladimir; content win[N] and the packet levelChart both read Lissandra/Skill/Skill/Lissandra/Lissandra/Lissandra/Lissandra. Six rows disagreed across layers. Also, tldr and report[0] claimed 'He out-ranges you' — Transfusion is 600, Ice Shard is 725.
audit.why: Vladimir's laning weakness is real and mechanical: Q/W/E all cost 0 mana, and Tides of Blood is paid for in his own health, so his early damage is low and self-taxing. The lane is even only where Sanguine Pool's 28s covers a commit; everywhere else it is Lissandra's.
audit.corrected: Full chart moved to match content and packet; tldr rewritten around the 725-vs-600 range edge.

audit.why: Every Vladimir ability costs 0 in Riot's text; his resource is health on Tides of Blood and the Crimson Rush charge on Transfusion. Calling him mana-starved sends the player to punish a bar that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real cost — he pays health to cast Tides of Blood — in whys[0], early and wants.you[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] warned he could 'pool your Ice Shard stun'. Ice Shard (Q) slows; the root is Ring of Frost (W).
audit.why: Sanguine Pool grants 2 seconds untargetable on a 28/25/22/19/16s cooldown, so it does dodge Ring of Frost's root and Frozen Tomb's stun — but not a Q that has already landed its slow. The missing-interactions file flags exactly this untargetable-dodges-burst case, plus his Transfusion/Hemoplague sustain making Grievous Wounds timing decisive.
audit.corrected: Corrected to 'he can pool out of your W root'; anti-heal and the Pool cooldown folded into breakdown.cooldowns and breakdown.carry.

audit.whatIsWrong: lintFindings COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT — breakdown.cooldowns had no number.
audit.why: The whole lane is a Pool-cooldown timing game and the field never said what that cooldown is.
audit.corrected: Pool 28s/16s, Transfusion 4.6s at rank 5, Frozen Tomb 120s/80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.
audit.why: Both were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to their titles, grounded in E's 24s and R's 120s.

notes: Two factual errors fixed: Vladimir called 'mana-starved' (all his abilities cost 0; Tides of Blood costs health), and 'He out-ranges you' (Transfusion 600 vs Ice Shard 725). Chart: full layer disagreed with content on six of seven rows; content already matched the packet, so only full-layer sides moved, each with its why rewritten in the same proposal — no win[N] edit was possible since the correct value is already on disk. Both missingInteractions entries are now stated: Sanguine Pool's 2s untargetable dodging your commit, and Grievous Wounds timing against Transfusion/Hemoplague sustain. Not asserted (kit silent): whether Sanguine Pool cast during Frozen Tomb's stun escapes it, and whether Hemoplague's damage amp applies to the Frozen Thrall shatter. Vladimir is male; pronouns unchanged.
